findings.problem: The hint example 'put a hat on' points to the separable verb aufsetzen ('den Hut aufsetzen'), which is what Germans actually say, so the hint is misleading.
findings.fix: hint: seat someone, place a bet (the putting that goes with sitzen)

back.target: to put, to set, to place (especially to seat someone or put something in a sitting position; to place a bet)
back.example: I'm betting ten euros on red.

note: sameAs null is defensible because poner-put is the general 'to put', which in German is split among legen, stellen and setzen.
